segments.text: Ok so, this is the components as tools page in the CopilotKit docs, for Vue with Google ADK, and I have implemented this page in my project.
So this is my project, umm, and this is the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for the Paris weather card, and the agent just typed a text card. The weather card component never rendered.
So here it says when the agent calls the tool, the component renders in the chat.
But there is no agent side on this page. A plain ADK agent never gets the component as a tool, so it just types a text card. Umm, with the AGUI toolset on the agent, the card shows up.
That is the problem here, please have a look.
